crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, triangular red-pigmented patch on the posterior crown/upper nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp color transition boundary between the red crown/nape patch and the uniform gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent black and white transverse barring on the tail rectrices.
